title: caps-scout SNMP plugin-match labels
name: caps-scout-snmp
description: Emits caps/snmp_plugin/<family> host labels identifying which of Checkmk's SNMP device plugin families (cisco, juniper, fortinet, aruba, hp_procurve, checkpoint, palo_alto, f5_bigip) would attach to this host, using the host's already-configured SNMP credentials. Also ships a 'Capabilities Scout' service listing every caps-scout caps/* host label (each with an 'Add rule' link to the matching bakery rule where one exists), and a bakery rule to deploy the caps-scout agent plugin itself.
author: caps-scout
